evidence.notes: Scope: pin numbers and pad multiset only. lead_d_mm 0.54 = typical 1/4 W metal-film lead (0.5-0.6); KiCad drill 0.8.

notes: ILLUSTRATIVE: lead size is the family-typical value, not read from a part datasheet. Unpolarised. Covers every axial 1/4 W resistor (blinky 3, uno-toggle 2, reflex 55). Real MPN binding goes through orderable_as at release (decision 9.2), empty on hand boards. Value range 1 ohm .. 10 Mohm is a sanity bound, not a datasheet limit.

p_max_mw.cond: CFR-25 style (0207, 6.3x2.4 mm body) power rating 1/4 W at 70 C, derated linearly to 0 at 155 C (p1); assumes the purchased resistor is a 1/4 W CFR-25-class part
